Class NeonConfig

java.lang.Object
com.quietterminal.neon.core.NeonConfig
public final class NeonConfig extends Object
Immutable configuration for all Neon components.

Obtain a default instance via defaults(), or customise with builder(): 

NeonConfig cfg = NeonConfig.builder()
        .relayPort(9001)
        .hostSessionTickRate((short) 30)
        .clientPingIntervalMs(2000)
        .build();

One NeonConfig instance can be shared across NeonSocket, host, client, and relay components.
